chunks: And indeed, seven hundred Prophets have prayed in Masjid al-Khayf at Mina.

key_terms.الْخَيْفِ: al-Khayf, the specific mosque in Mina
key_terms.بِمِنًى: in Mina, the well-known site connected to hajj rites
key_terms.مَسْجِدِ: mosque; the sacred place of prayer being mentioned

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of Masjid al-Khayf in Mina according to hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the great sanctity and historical virtue of Masjid al-Khayf in Mina by noting that many Prophets prayed there. It highlights the honored status of this place within the rites and sacred geography of hajj.
